## Rust Spewer (CR 3)

This heavyset creature hops awkwardly on four legs, its skin warty and toadlike. Droplets fall off its trumpet-like mouth, and you see them hiss and burn through the ground.  


**XP** 800  
N Medium magical beast  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +7  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural)  
**hp** 34 (4d10+12)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +6, **Will** +2  
**Immune** acid  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** tongue +6 (1d8 acid plus rust), 2 claws +6 (1d4+2)  
**Ranged** spittle +7 touch (1d8 acid plus rust)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 15, **Dex** 14, **Con** 17, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 6  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 19 (23 vs. trip)  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Weapon Focus (spittle)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Perception +7, Stealth +6  


**Special Abilities**


**Rust (Ex)** Acid of rust spewers has highly oxidizing properties, causing any metal object it touches to swiftly rust and corrode. The object touched takes half its maximum hp in damage and gains the broken condition—a second hit destroys the item. An attended object or any magic object can attempt a DC 15 Fortitude save to negate this effect. If hit by a rust spewer’s tongue or spittle, any metal armor that the creature hit wears is subject to this effect. Against creatures made of metal, a rust spewer deals double acid damage. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Spittle (Ex)** A rust spewer’s spittle has a maximum range of 30 ft., with no range increment.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or pack (3–14)  
**Treasure** none
